bio: With easy access to the Metro, Rasika is a good-looking, loud, and lively spot that lures all types of diners. Everyone is here for their kitsch-free Indian cuisine and laid-back ambience—both of which are as perfectly suited for a casual night out with friends as they are for a formal dinner with colleagues or festive celebration.Rasika is beloved for their popular dishes ranging from well-spiced kebabs and fresh curries to a vibrant lamb rogan josh with layers of flavor. Word to the wise: the breads, especially the naan, are outstanding, so order two because one is just not enough....
